sections.content: Use mientras to connect two actions that happened at the same time. It tells the learner that one action was happening while another was happening. In this unit, practise the connector with past actions and keep the focus on describing what happened during the same period.

items.spanish: Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con los voluntarios.
items.english: While we worked, we spoke with the volunteers.

items.spanish: Mientras limpiamos el parque, plantamos flores.
items.english: While we cleaned the park, we planted flowers.

items.spanish: Mientras recogimos basura, otros voluntarios limpiaron el lago.
items.english: While we collected rubbish, other volunteers cleaned the lake.

items.spanish: Mientras colaboramos, conocemos a nuevas personas.
items.english: While we collaborate, we meet new people.

sections.content: Use cuando to say when a completed event happened. Use mientras when two actions happened at the same time.
